title: TwistedCoordinateSectionProjective
statement: Fix the finite purity datum [def-pur-conventions] and a scheme $T$. Define projectiveZero to be the affine zero section followed by the standard chart in the projective line [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], [def-pur-coordinate-section-ordinary-arrows]. When it is a closed Cartier immersion, define projectiveSupported at each positive invertible exponent killing the coefficient ring to be the derived realization of the unique supported ordinary Kummer class [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer]. ProjectiveNormalization is the proposition that its ideal is invertible, its dual ideal (the divisor line bundle of [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle]) is isomorphic to the specified projective $\mathcal O(1)$, and, at every allowed annihilating exponent, forgetting support by the actual supported constant unit gives the positive Kummer Chern class used by the trace [def-amb-p1-trace].
